title: Sample faster with DDIM and EDM
brief: Build DDIM's deterministic and stochastic updates, the VP probability-flow ODE, EDM's noise levels, and Heun sampler, all checked against closed-form Gaussian answers.
hints: ddim_step: form x0_hat first, then rebuild x at the new noise level from x0_hat and the same eps_hat.
In ddim_sample, append 0 to the steps so the last update lands on alpha_bar[0] = 1, the data.
pf_ode_sample steps backward in time, so t_next - t is negative.
edm_sample: Heun averages the slope at the current point and at the Euler guess; skip the correction on the step to sigma = 0, where the slope would divide by zero.
